objective: Produce a broad, high-quality Canva creative baseline for Fenix/CEREBRO while preserving all existing Canva content and publishing nothing outside Canva.

batch_plan.name: Inventory and structure
actions: identify Capital brand kit and reusable assets
create or reuse a dedicated Fenix CEREBRO workspace/folder structure without deleting existing content

batch_plan.name: Brand and reusable masters
actions: create reusable master styles and layout systems
create post, story, reel cover, carousel, testimonial, FAQ, comparison and educational masters
create variants for personal-brand and corporate use

batch_plan.name: Static creative production
actions: use distinct hypotheses and visual directions

batch_plan.name: Image and AI experimentation
actions: use premium Canva capabilities only when included in plan

batch_plan.name: Video and motion drafts
actions: add captions and on-screen text where appropriate
leave drafts in Canva and do not publish

batch_plan.name: Platform adaptation
actions: prepare reusable variants for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and web
do not treat resize alone as native adaptation

batch_plan.name: Final QA and handoff
actions: produce an inventory of created assets and next experiments
